meta_title: Smiths Secured It | Emergency Locksmith Nottingham
meta_description: Smiths Secured It is your trusted emergency locksmith in Nottingham. Fast callouts, lock repairs, and key cutting. Call now for rapid assistance.
hero_subhead: We arrive in under an hour. Locks opened, replaced, and repaired any time of day. No damage, no fuss.
services_subhead: From emergency callouts to routine maintenance, we handle every lock problem with speed and expertise.

services.title: Emergency Lockout
services.desc: Locked out of your home or car? We're on the road within 45 minutes, any time day or night. Non-destructive entry whenever possible.

services.title: Lock Repair & Replacement
services.desc: Broken locks, seized mechanisms, or worn keys? We repair or replace locks fast, fitted to your door the same day.

services.title: UPVC & Composite Doors
services.desc: Specialist repairs for modern UPVC and composite door locks. We carry the most common mechanisms on our van.

services.title: Key Cutting
services.desc: Spare keys cut while you wait. We stock blanks for domestic, commercial, and security locks.

services.title: Commercial & Business Locks
services.desc: Master key systems, high-security locks, and access control for offices and retail premises across Nottingham.

services.title: Lock Maintenance
services.desc: Regular servicing keeps locks working smoothly and extends their life. We help prevent costly callouts down the line.

about_pullquote: A call at midnight shouldn't mean a massive bill and a broken door.
about_para_1: Smiths Secured It started in 2012 when our founder decided Nottingham needed a locksmith who actually answers the phone at 2am. Twelve years later, we've opened thousands of homes and cars, earned the trust of dozens of local businesses, and built a reputation for turning up fast and sorting the job right first time.
about_para_2: We're based in Hucknall and know every corner of Greater Nottingham. Customers call us back because we're transparent with pricing, we don't upsell, and we treat your home like it's our own. Whether you're locked out, hit a break-in, or just need a spare key, you get a real locksmith who cares.
reviews_heading: What Nottingham Homeowners Say About Us

reviews.text: Locked myself out on a Sunday evening in the pouring rain. Called Smiths and they were here in less than an hour. Got me back in without damaging the door. Brilliant service and a fair price. Wouldn't hesitate to recommend.
reviews.author: Michael T.

reviews.text: Had a dodgy lock on my front door that kept jamming. Called them on a Saturday morning and they came out same day, replaced it, and fitted new keys. Professional, quick, and honest about the cost. Top marks.
reviews.author: Claire H.

reviews.text: Emergency callout at midnight after a break-in attempt. The team arrived promptly, secured the property, and fitted a new, stronger lock. Made me feel safe again. Can't thank them enough.
reviews.author: David P.
